pages.title: Build the identity foundation | Secure By Design

pages.description: Design the organizational unit structure, apply the DISA STIG Group Policy package to the verified network core, and prove the result with before-and-after SCAP scans, reconciled checklists, and a documented exception record.

Give the PKI its services: the pki.sbd.test publication site on SBD-PKI-MGMT01, trust data at the exact embedded URLs, template administration on its own seat, and the lab's first working templates proven by pilot autoenrollment.

Build a two-tier public key infrastructure with an offline standalone Root CA and an enterprise subordinate/issuing CA. Follow the signing ceremony, publish trust and revocation data, and validate enrollment.
h1: Configure a Root CA & issuing CA

pages.description: Bring the eight VLANs online through a router the lab controls. Enforce default deny with a documented exception register, stand up the internal time service, and prove every permitted path and denial from the Windows side.

Build the control plane before the fleet: DHCP with its core relay for the workstation VLAN, three dedicated administration systems in VLAN 60, and directory-enforced tier restrictions proven by both successful in-tier sessions and logged out-of-tier denials.

Build the model's collect → protect → analyze chain: Windows Event Forwarding and router syslog into SBD-SYSLOG01, hashed archives under a no-delete rule on SBD-AUDIT01, and working searches with one owned alert on SBD-SPLUNK01 — proven by a single event traced end to end.

Keep the proven state from drifting: Windows updates through WSUS rings fed across the air gap, one approved source per software type with SBD-REPO01 for packages, a living inventory on SBD-MGMT01, managed endpoint protection through SBD-EPO01, and SBD-NESSUS01 turning the scan cadence into routine.
h1: Patch, protect, and watch for weakness

pages.description: Join the fifty-workstation fleet to a network that is ready for it: DHCP addressing, OU landing with STIG policy at first boot, Windows LAPS for every local administrator, certificate autoenrollment at scale, and a sampled proof with the whole rollout observed by the logging pipeline.

Give the users what the network exists for: SBD-FS01's role-based shares over verified SMB security, SBD-SQL01 running as a managed identity behind exactly two callers, SBD-APPS01's licensing service, and SBD-WEB01 serving internal HTTPS from a hardened Apache — every hop a documented, proven register row.

Close the Build path by proving the network can come back: scheduled directory and CA backups under ceremony-grade custody, policy, boundary, logs, and the living records in one hashed catalog, a timed restore rehearsal in isolation, and the recovery record that completes the Body of Evidence.
